issue: Can a defendant who is representing himself pro se continue to do so at a competency hearing, or must counsel represent him at that hearing?
provision: U.S. Const. amend. VI (right to counsel)

sides.position: A pro se defendant may continue to represent himself at a competency hearing.
A pro se defendant may not continue to represent himself at a competency hearing; counsel must be provided for that critical stage.

quote: Whether a pro se litigant can continue to represent himself at a competency hearing is an issue on which other circuits are divided, and it is an issue of first impression for our circuit.
cite: United States v. Sterling, 99 F.4th 783 (5th Cir. 2024)
